items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm Paul Crawford. ... [INTERVIEWER] ... I don't know what you call them, Paul.

ctx.x: Jack T. Yorden. And what's your name?
I'm Paul Crawford. Okay, fine. We got that. Now, where were you born, Jack?
Well, I was born over in Vernon, Texas, in 1905. That's a little town in the northern part of, northwestern part of Texas, near the Oklahoma border in Wilburga County.
